notes.title: Small patch released
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

We've released a small patch making the cursor 'stay' within the screen borders. Additionally, on touchscreen devices pressing Alt+C will hide the cursor. It's around 5MB, so you'll be back in the game in no time!

Enjoy the slashing time!

Ninjas@Mass Creation
